description: Website WebUnlocker. BrowserSolver's highest HTML fetch tier for retail and marketplace hosts on your account whitelist. Solves persistent bot challenges that still block Rendering. Credit cost: 3 credits per call.

allow_redirects.description: Whether the unlock session should chase HTTP redirects. Default: true.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: Public URL to fetch with the WebUnlocker tier. Include http:// or https://. The hostname must be on your BrowserSolver whitelist.

return_page_source.description: Choose between processed markup and the exact post-unlock source. Default: false.

name: website_webunlocker
title: Website WebUnlocker
